source: Kolkata (Hooghly), Ahmedabad (Sabarmati), Surat (Tapi), Guwahati (Brahmaputra); Jaisalmer is in the Thar desert, Bengaluru and Shillong sit on no major river.

title: Botany ke hisaab se yeh 'sabziyan' asal mein fruit hain

title: Yeh Indian Railways ki asli chalti hui trains hain

source: Standard cricket fielding chart includes silly point, fine leg, short leg and deep square leg; the other three are made up.

title: Yeh dishes asal mein bahar se aayi (videshi origin) hain
source: Food historians: samosa descends from the Central Asian/Persian sanbosag, jalebi from Persian zolabiya, vindaloo from Portuguese carne de vinha d'alhos; dosa, khichdi and chaat are Indian-origin.

source: TMKOC (SAB TV) cast list; Monisha and Rosesh are from Sarabhai vs Sarabhai, Gutthi from Comedy Nights with Kapil.

title: Yeh cheezein originally India ki dein hain
source: Chaturanga became chess, English 'shampoo' comes from champo, Snakes and Ladders from Gyan Chaupar, and the written zero digit appears in the Bakhshali manuscript; Bluetooth is Ericsson, Post-it 3M, escalator American.

title: In cricketers ne ODI mein double century thoki hai
source: ODI 200s: Sachin 200*, Sehwag 219, Rohit 264/209/208, Ishan 210, Gill 208; Kohli's ODI best is 183, Dhoni's 183*, Yuvraj's 150.

source: Weddings: Ranveer-Deepika (2018), Saif-Kareena (2012), Ranbir-Alia (2022), Akshay-Twinkle (2001); SRK is married to Gauri, Kajol to Ajay Devgn; Salman-Katrina never married; Jethalal-Babita is a sitcom daydream.

title: Yeh cities kisi Indian state ki capital hain
source: Bhopal (MP), Dispur (Assam), Panaji (Goa), Raipur (Chhattisgarh); Gujarat's capital is Gandhinagar, Kerala's is Thiruvananthapuram, Surat is not a capital.

title: In sports films ka khel cricket hai

title: Yeh apps/companies India mein born hui hain
source: Flipkart (Bengaluru, 2007), Zomato (Gurugram, 2008), Ola (2010), Paytm (Noida, 2010) were founded in India; WhatsApp and Instagram are American, Telegram was founded by the Durov brothers.

title: In films ko Filmfare Best Film award mila hai
source: Filmfare Best Film: Lagaan (2002), 3 Idiots (2010), Dangal (2017), Gully Boy (2020); Sholay famously won only Best Editing, Andaz Apna Apna and Om Shanti Om never won Best Film.

title: Yeh teams IPL trophy jeet chuki hain (2025 tak)
source: IPL winners list: CSK (5), MI (5), SRH (2016), RCB (2025); Delhi, Punjab and Lucknow are title-less, Punjab Kings lost the 2025 final.

title: In actors ne National Film Award (Best Actor) jeeta hai
source: National Best Actor: Amitabh (Agneepath, Black, Paa, Piku), Akshay (Rustom/Airlift, 2017), SRK (Jawan, announced 2025), Ayushmann (Andhadhun, 2019, shared); Salman, Govinda and Katrina have never won it.

title: Yeh desi drinks non-alcoholic hain
source: Lassi, jaljeera, nimbu paani and plain thandai are non-alcoholic; feni, toddy and mahua are traditional alcoholic drinks.

source: CID main cast: ACP Pradyuman, Daya, Abhijeet, Freddy; Jethalal is TMKOC, Mihir Virani is Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi, Munna Bhai is a film character.

title: Yeh airlines 2025 mein India mein sach mein udd rahi hain
source: IndiGo, Air India, Akasa and SpiceJet operate in 2025; Kingfisher Airlines shut in 2012, Jet Airways grounded in 2019 (liquidation ordered 2024), Shatabdi is a train, not an airline.

title: Yeh mobile brands Indian companies hain
source: Micromax, Lava, Karbonn and Intex are Indian-founded handset brands; Oppo, Vivo and Xiaomi are Chinese companies.

title: Yeh shows Kapil Sharma ne host kiye hain
source: Kapil hosted TKSS (Sony), Comedy Nights (Colors), The Great Indian Kapil Show (Netflix, 2024) and Family Time (Sony, 2018); on Comedy Circus he was a contestant, not host.

title: Yeh cricket stadiums India mein hain
source: Eden Gardens (Kolkata), Wankhede (Mumbai), Chinnaswamy (Bengaluru), Chepauk (Chennai); Lord's and Old Trafford are in England, MCG in Australia.

title: In janwaron ko India ka official national symbol status mila hai
source: Tiger = national animal (since 1972), peacock = national bird, elephant = national heritage animal (2010), Gangetic dolphin = national aquatic animal (2009); the lion lost national-animal status to the tiger in 1972.

title: Yeh chess ke asli official terms hain
source: FIDE rules and standard chess vocabulary include castling, en passant, stalemate and zugzwang; the other three are invented.

title: Yeh officially recognized Indian classical dance forms hain

title: Yeh sports Paris Olympics 2024 mein khele gaye

title: Yeh desi words officially Oxford English Dictionary mein hain
source: OED additions: aiyo (2016), jugaad and chuddies (2017), timepass (2018); the last three are memes/slang not in the OED.

title: In logon ne Nobel Prize jeeta hai

title: In dates par poore India mein sharaab ki dukaanein band rehti hain (national dry day)

title: In films mein Sunny Leone ne kaam kiya hai
source: Sunny Leone filmography: Jism 2 (2012), Ragini MMS 2 (2014), Ek Paheli Leela (2015), Mastizaade (2016); Queen is Kangana Ranaut, Cocktail is Deepika, Pink is Taapsee.

source: Patiala peg (extra-large peg), khamba (750 ml bottle), quarter (180 ml) and nip are drink measures; chakna is the snack, cutting is half-glass chai, jugaad is a hack.
